title: cordia obliqua var. wallichii
intro: Cordia obliqua var. wallichii, commonly known as the 'Wish Tree', is a plant species native to India and Southeast Asia. It is prized for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and stress, and promote sleep. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Cordia obliqua var. wallichii include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
